title: FOODEEG: An open dataset of human electroencephalographic and behavioural responses to food images
description: FOODEEG is an open dataset of electroencephalographic (EEG) and behavioural responses to food images from 117 participants. In one session, EEG was recorded during a food categorisation task in which participants judged images as healthy, tasty, or something they were willing to eat. In a second session, participants completed a food go/no-go task, a paired choice task, and questionnaires on dietary style and motivation. The dataset also includes raw and cleaned EEG data and normative ratings of the food stimuli from online samples.
methods_description: Session 1 recorded EEG (BDF format) while participants viewed food images for 2 s and made yes/no judgements of healthiness, tastiness, or willingness to eat. They then gave continuous 0-100 ratings of each image. Session 2 comprised a food go/no-go task, a food paired choice task, and questionnaires on dietary style, eating motivations, general motivational tendencies and hedonism. Normative ratings on 22 food attributes were collected separately from online samples (N = 624).
